messages:
alex.sales: Quick Q from Meridian Health POC 8: they need SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning with group-to-role mapping, RBAC enforcement on the app side, and domain claim verification before self-service signups. Also asked whether SCIM writes and SAML increase hosted pricing or require Dedicated.

mike.eng: We support SP-initiated + IdP-initiated SAML, signed assertions, optional encrypted assertions, and metadata URL rotation. Group-role mapping is configured in the Console via SCIM group sync -> role bindings.

sarah.se: SCIM support: SCIM 2.0 with incremental (PATCH) and bulk endpoints. We honor custom schemas and enterprise attributes; recommend using delta sync for production to limit load. For a large initial import we'll suggest a staged full-sync.

toni.prod: How do we verify domain ownership for signup gating? DNS TXT is our standard; CNAME is available. For on-prem/Private installs customers can present a cert or use a signed attestation.

emma.sec: Security items to confirm with the customer: admin MFA enforcement, SAML assertion attributes minimization, SCIM bearer token rotation policy, audit log retention, and SOC2/HIPAA attestation needs. Also confirm if they'd need our HSM integration for key storage.

alex.sales: The buyer asked whether enabling SSO/SCIM would automatically push them to Dedicated because of compliance \u2014 they want to avoid heavy contractual commitments for POC.

mike.eng: Short answer: SSO/SCIM features are available on Hosted. For predictable throughput during a one-time 75k user import or for network isolation (VPC), Dedicated is recommended. We can do a hosted staging import with rate-limiting or a short-term resource reservation.

alex.sales: They want a price estimate for a one-off import.

sarah.se: We have two options: 1) Hosted POC with a temporary "sync reservation" fee (covers CPU/GPU/IO) — estimated $2k for a 24h window for 75k users; 2) Dedicated trial (short-term commitment) priced by capacity tier. We can waive the reservation fee if they sign an MSA addendum.

toni.prod: POC checklist: need test IdP metadata, SCIM token with scoped write, mapping CSV (group -> role), list of sample users, and preferred off-hours window. Also ask whether they need SCIM write disabled for some groups.

alex.sales: I'll collect metadata and questionnaire. Any legal flags?

emma.sec: Ensure their security questionnaire includes retention windows, incident response SLAs, and contact for breach notif. If they claim HIPAA, we need a BAA in place before production. For POC we can run under a data processing addendum.

okta-bot: (automated) SAML metadata upload confirmed for meridian-health-poc.

mike.eng: SCIM staging endpoints:
```
POST https://staging-api.redwood.infra/scim/v2/Users
PATCH https://staging-api.redwood.infra/scim/v2/Users/<id>
Authorization: Bearer <scim-token>
Content-Type: application/scim+json
```
Use bulk endpoint for large batches, set chunk sizes to 500, and respect 429 backoff.

sarah.se: We'll prepare a runbook and a small test harness for their IdP to validate mapping. Recommend a 2-week staging sync before cutover.

toni.prod: I'll add the runbook to the ticket and propose the off-hours import next Friday.

alex.sales: Thanks team, looping in customer now. Will post updates. :pray:
